props.name: actions
props.description: Which actions to show, in this order

props.name: defaultVersion
props.description: Starting version when uncontrolled – defaults to the newest

props.name: onFeedback
props.type: ((kind: FeedbackKind | null, reason?: string) => void) | undefined
props.description: "up" or "down" when a thumb is pressed, null when it is taken back, and "down" with a reason when the feedback row is sent

props.name: onRegenerate
props.description: Called when Regenerate is pressed – add a version and the switcher jumps to it

props.name: onSpeak
props.description: Called with true when Read aloud starts and false when it stops

props.name: onVersionChange
props.description: Called with the version index picked in the switcher

props.name: quiet
props.description: Faded until the message is hovered (default true). Put data-ui-message on the message wrapper

props.name: reasons
props.description: Quick reasons in the feedback row. "Other" opens a small text field

props.name: regenerating
props.description: Keeps the regenerate arrow spinning while a new version is written

props.name: speakDuration
props.description: How long an uncontrolled read aloud plays, in ms – defaults to an estimate from `text`

props.name: speaking
props.description: Controlled playing state, e.g. tied to your speech player

props.name: text
props.description: The message text – copied to the clipboard by Copy and used to time Read aloud

props.name: versions
props.description: All versions of the message, or just how many there are. From 2 on the version switcher shows
